crossRefs.note: Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

parallels.note: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of Yahweh my God.
Now it was in the heart of David my father to build a house for the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: But Yahweh said to David my father, ‘Whereas it was in your heart to build a house for my name, you did well that it was in your heart.
translations.bsb: But the LORD said to my father David, ‘Since it was in your heart to build a house for My Name, you have done well to have this in your heart.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thine heart to build an house unto my name, thou didst well that it was in thine heart.
translations.asv: But Jehovah said unto David my father, Whereas it was in thy heart to build a house for my name, thou didst well that it was in thy heart:
